title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection

problem.summary: Dataset + Image patch Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning.
statements: Dataset + Image patch Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning.
However, handling diverse vision tasks-spanning dense and sparse predictions-remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures.

In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection.

Additionally, we define k shallow, taskspecific projectors Hψj j , each designed to align the output shape with the requirements of task j.

Our objective is to train an encoder-decoder network that learns a shared and robust feature map F = Dϕ (Bθ (·)), ensuring it captures all the essential information needed to perform various vision tasks.
